stem: Northbridge Retail uses four AWS accounts and needs shared database commitment savings plus team-level chargeback by application owner tags.

choices.text: Use AWS Budgets alerts and skip activating cost allocation tags.
Use Cost Explorer grouped by service only and skip account-level sharing controls.
Use Compute Savings Plans as the sole discount strategy for standard RDS DB instance hours.
Use consolidated billing and activate cost allocation tags for chargeback.

rationale: Consolidated billing enables sharing of reserved database discounts across organization accounts, and activated cost allocation tags support chargeback reporting. Budgets alerts do not replace tag activation for allocation data. Cost Explorer service grouping alone does not configure commitment sharing policy. Compute Savings Plans do not apply to standard RDS DB instance hours.
